modules.name: `[theme]`
modules.text: One `[theme]` in `limanix.toml` colors the editor, the prompt, tmux, Lazygit, Yazi, bat, delta, Harlequin and Posting.

modules.name: AstroNvim
modules.text: AstroNvim brings Neovim and Lazygit and picks up language servers from the toolchains.

modules.name: bat
modules.text: bat and delta highlight in the colors of the theme.

modules.name: btop
modules.text: Watch CPU, memory and processes.

modules.name: delta
modules.text: `git diff` and `git log -p` page through delta.

modules.name: fd
modules.text: Find files by name.

modules.name: fzf
modules.text: In Zsh, Ctrl-T inserts paths and Alt-C changes directory through fzf.

modules.name: GitHub CLI
modules.text: `gh` for pull requests and issues, next to Git.

modules.name: jq
modules.text: Read and reshape JSON.

modules.name: ripgrep
modules.text: Search file contents.

modules.name: Lazygit
modules.text: `Space g g` in AstroNvim opens Lazygit.

modules.name: Neovim
modules.text: AstroNvim runs on it; on its own, Neovim is a plain editor.

modules.name: tmux
modules.text: The same keys move between tmux panes and AstroNvim splits.

modules.name: Yazi
modules.text: Leave Yazi with `q`, and your shell moves to its folder.

modules.name: Zsh
modules.text: Zsh comes with Oh My Zsh, a Pure or Starship prompt, and fzf on Ctrl-T and Alt-C.

modules.name: Oh My Zsh
modules.text: Oh My Zsh comes with the Zsh module, along with completion and history.

modules.name: Pure
modules.text: The default Zsh prompt, in the colors of the theme.

modules.name: Starship
modules.text: `prompt = "starship"` swaps Pure for Starship with the theme palette.

modules.name: Go
modules.text: `gopls` reaches AstroNvim when both are on.

modules.name: Node.js
modules.text: The TypeScript server reaches AstroNvim when both are on.

modules.name: Python
modules.text: Pyright reaches AstroNvim when both are on.

modules.name: Rust
modules.text: `rust-analyzer` reaches AstroNvim when both are on.

modules.name: Claude Code
modules.text: Anthropic's coding agent for the terminal.

modules.name: Docker
modules.text: Docker Engine comes with Compose and Lazydocker.

modules.name: Google Cloud CLI
modules.text: `gcloud` for projects and accounts.

modules.name: Harlequin
modules.text: Harlequin comes with the PostgreSQL adapter.

modules.name: PostgreSQL
modules.text: Open the database in Harlequin, a terminal SQL IDE.

modules.name: Posting
modules.text: A terminal HTTP client in the colors of the theme.
